title: Weak arcs and applications to the DNA-based storage access problem
summary: Weak arcs are point sets in PG$(n-1,q)$ meeting every general hyperplane (those are the hyperplanes not going through one of the points given by the standard basis vectors) in at most $n-1$ points. In this paper, we study weak arcs together with balanced variants which are contained on the sides of the fundamental simplex. We give an upper bound on the size of weak arcs, characterise the largest balanced quasi-arcs in the plane and construct large balanced quasi-arcs in PG$(3, q)$.
